items.detail: The **Nasdaq** rose 1.18% to 26,477.81 Tuesday and the S&P 500 added 0.6% to 7,722.60, a second straight winning day for both.
items.why: Chip stocks rallied 3.6% for a third session as Anthropic's IPO plans kept AI enthusiasm running.

items.detail: The Dow lagged, edging up just **0.03%** to 52,377.57, with energy the weakest sector of the day.
items.why: Oil slipped on Gulf diplomacy, dragging energy shares while money rotated into chipmakers.

items.detail: The **Fed** decides at 2 p.m. ET today, and with a hold nearly certain, Chair Kevin Warsh's hints about December are what markets will trade.
items.why: Futures price about 84% odds of a December hike while oil near $115 keeps inflation fears alive.

items.detail: South Korea's **Kospi** jumped as much as **6.5%** Wednesday and topped 6,000 during the session, then settled back into the 5,900s.
items.why: SK hynix posted a record quarterly profit and a huge shareholder payout plan, lifting Samsung and memory chipmakers too.

items.detail: The **Sensex** fell nearly 900 points Wednesday and the Nifty dropped close to **22,500**, after closing flat at 22,749.75 Tuesday.
items.why: Brent climbed back toward $115 on reports of new US strikes on Iran, while IT stocks and Fed caution added pressure.

items.detail: Small caps rallied in two markets Tuesday: the US **Russell 2000** rose 1.16% to 2,818.87, and India's Nifty Smallcap 100 jumped **2.7%**.
items.why: Softer oil and the revived AI trade drew buyers into smaller, riskier stocks even as big benchmarks lagged.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** rose nearly 2% to just under **$81,000** early Wednesday, recovering from a dip to about $79,400.
items.why: Spot bitcoin ETFs took in $110 million Monday, ending a run of heavy outflows ahead of the Fed.

items.detail: **Ether** slipped 1.5% to about **$2,312** Tuesday, sitting right on its 200-day moving average, a level traders watch closely.
items.why: Spot ether ETFs lost another $88.6 million Monday, mostly from BlackRock's fund.

items.detail: **Solana** held just above **$100** into Wednesday, with buyers defending that level for a third straight session.
items.why: Solana ETFs saw $19.2 million of outflows Tuesday, adding to $72 million already withdrawn in October.

items.detail: **Gold** slipped 0.3% to about **$4,045** early Wednesday, giving back part of Tuesday's climb above $4,060.
items.why: Oil pushing back toward $115 revived fears the Fed will signal a December hike, which hurts gold.

crossCuttingTheme: AI chip earnings and Anthropic's IPO lifted stocks from Nasdaq to Seoul, but Brent stuck near $115 on Iran strike fears keeps December hike odds high, weighing on India, gold and crypto before today's Fed decision.
